lines: I remember the cure flying true when everything else had gone crooked.
You set me back on the string and did not let me snap.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
Your face lands near the target, but the rest of the memory wobbles.
There was a hiss, a bite of gold, and then my thoughts found their fletching.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you. The arrow of it still shakes in the target.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left echoes behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
I have seen broken arrows with better instincts than you.
